content: Sosep Kawehwehda en Tohnimwetengo Ara Ouraman kan
Kedekedeo, sounkohwahn wain, oh kaunen wia pilawahn nanmwarki, ira koaros kahngiangihada nanmwarkien Isip.
Parao eri engiengda pahra,
oh ketikihlong ira nan imweteng rehn kaunen silasil ko; wasaohte me Sosep wie sensel ie.
Kaunen silasilo eri kilelehiong Sosep pwe en papah ira. Irail ahpw mihmi nan imwetengo ahnsou reirei.
Pwohng ehu, sounkohwahn wain oh kaunen pilawahn nanmwarkio ira koaros ahpw ouramanda. Eri, wehwehn ara ouraman ko wekpeseng.
Sosep lao pedolong rehra nimengseng, e ahpw kasawihada ara mwomwen pahtou.
Ih eri idek rehra, “Dahkot mwo, maing ko, dahme kumwa mwomwen pahtouki rahnwet?”

Ira ahpw sapeng, nda, “Ahki kiht koaros se ouraman pwohng. Eri, sohte emen met me kak kawehwehiong kiht wehwehn at ouraman ko.” Sosep ahpw ndahng ira, “Koht kelehpw me kak ketin kawehwehda ouraman kan. Nna, kumwa ndadohng ie amwa ouraman kan.”
Sounkohwahn waino eri nda, “I ouraman me tuhkehn wain pwoat mi mwohi
me rah siluh mie. Ni tehntuhkeo eh pwerla oh wah, wahn wain akan eri mahla.
I wie kolokol sapwellimen Parao dahlo. I ahpw dolungete wahn wain ako, wengidediong nan dahlo, oh loangedahng Parao.”
Sosep ahpw ndaiong, “Eri, iet wehwehn ouramanen: rahn tuhkehn wain siluho wehwehki rahn siluh me luhwe.
Mwurin rahn siluh Parao pahn kasaledekeiukala, mahkohng uhk, oh kapwurehiong uhk nan deumw. Ke pahn loangedahng sapwellime dahl duwen me ke kin wia mahso, ni omw kin sounkohwahn wain.
A ke ahpw tamantaman ie nan omw paiamwahu, oh menlau kataman ie rehn nanmarkio, pwe en ketikihsang ie nan imweteng wet.
Pwe ngehi aramas emen me pirapodohsang nan sapwen mehn Ipru kan, oh lao lel met sohte mehkot I wiahda pwe re en keseiehlong nan imweteng wet.”
Eri, ni kaunen wie pilawa eh rongada duwen kawehwehpen ouramano eh mwahu, e ahpw pil ndahng Sosep, “Ngehi pil ouraman. Eri, iet duwe: I ouraman me kopwoun pilawa siluh poasoakehda pohn moangeiet.
Kopwou me keieu powe, inenen audaud en soangen kisin konot koaros, konot en Parao; ahpw menpihr kan wie kangkang.”
Sosep eri sapeng, nda, “Iet wehwe: kopwou siluho wehwehki rahn siluh me luhwe.
Eri, mwurin rahn siluh Parao pahn ketikihsang uhk nan imwetenget oh lupukasang moangomwen. E ahpw pahn langadahng uhk ni apwoat tuhkehn; menpihr kan ahpw pahn kangasang uduk en paliwaromwen.”
Eri, rahn siluh mwuri, rahnen ipwidien Parao, lapalahn kamadipw ehu ahpw wiawihong tohn tehnpeseo koaros. Ih eri malipehdo sapwellime sounkohwahn waino, oh pil kaunen pilawao, mwohn lapalap ako.
Ih eri ketin kapwurehiong sounkohwahn waino nan dewe;
a kaunen wie pilawao e ketin langahda nin tuhke pwoat. Ih duwen eh pweida ouraman ko me Sosep kawehwehda.
Ahpw iet sounkohwahn waino nan eh pai, e ahpw manokehla, oh sohte tamanda Sosep.
